events.title: Demo Update 0.13.50 — Boss Navigation & Core Balance
events.summary: Thank you for playing the Voltswarm Demo and for continuing to share your feedback! This update focuses on fixing a navigation issue and improving two sustain Cores that were having too little impact during runs. Main changes Improved boss navigation: We increased the space between Scrapyard containers to prevent Tesla Titan and other bosses from getting stuck between them. events.title: Voltswarm Demo — Quality-of-Life Update
events.summary: We’ve released a small update focused on interface polish and clearer progression. Text can no longer be accidentally selected while navigating menus. Images no longer trigger unwanted dragging. Steam Overlay initialization has been improved. Contracts involving multiple weapons now show which weapons have already counted toward their objective. Thanks for playing and helping us improve Voltswarm! — The Voltswarm Team

events.title: The Voltswarm Demo Is Available Now
events.summary: The Voltswarm Demo is now available to play for free on Steam. Step into the Scrapyard, build your loadout, and survive an ever-growing machine swarm in this 3D voxel bullet heaven. This demo represents the first playable slice of Voltswarm, and we want to keep improving it with your help. Constructive feedback about balance, controls, performance, readability, or the overall experience would be genuinely valuable to us. Thank you for playing and helping us make Voltswarm better.
